story.lead: I believe fitness can change far more than the way you look. For me, training changed my confidence, energy, productivity, and how I show up in everyday life. But balancing fitness with a demanding career and family taught me something even more important:
body: For me, training changed my confidence, energy, productivity, and how I show up in everyday life. But balancing fitness with a demanding career and family taught me something even more important:
You don't need extreme diets, endless workouts, or a life built around fitness. I believe in small, sustainable changes that compound over time into real results.
story.mission: That's why I started coaching: to help busy people build a stronger, healthier body in a way that actually fits their life.

notFor.label: Who This Isn't For
notFor.heading: I don't work with everyone, and that's intentional.
notFor.lead: Good coaching works best when there’s a good fit on both sides. I work best with people who are ready to take ownership of their progress, make realistic changes and stay consistent.
notFor.intro: This approach probably isn't for you if:

items.title: You're under 30
body: My coaching is designed primarily for busy adults over 30, where work, family, recovery and limited time often make fitness more complicated.
If you're younger, this may not be the best fit unless your lifestyle and challenges are similar.

items.title: You're looking for quick fixes or extreme transformations
body: I'm not here to promise unrealistic results in a few weeks.

items.title: You want a strict meal plan telling you exactly what to eat
body: The goal is to help you understand your nutrition and make better decisions, not follow a restrictive diet forever.

items.title: You want someone to push you through workouts every day
body: This isn't personal training. I help you build the right training approach, structure and progression so you can train independently.

notFor.closing: If that sounds like the kind of approach you're looking for, we'll probably work well together.

finalCta.label: Initiation · System active
finalCta.heading: Ready to calibrate
finalCta.reassurance: Strictly limited coaching seats. Secure your baseline diagnostic today and replace physical exhaustion with athletic longevity.

steps.title: Understand the baseline
body: I look beyond your weight: body composition, activity, nutrition, training history and lifestyle.
The goal is to understand what's actually driving your current results.

steps.title: Control the variables
body: Calories, protein, training volume, intensity and recovery all matter.
I focus on the variables that matter most for your specific goal, without making fitness unnecessarily complicated.

steps.title: Track progress
body: The first plan is never the final plan.
I track how your body and performance respond, then adjust based on progress, not assumptions.
